output.explanation: The QFL 2026 renewal was signed March 20 and took effect April 1, 2026. It sets a 10% discount ($1,920 list, $1,728 net per seat), so that rate applies on May 1, 2026. The April 9 debrief's claim that the discount 'stays 12%' conflicts with the signed instrument, so the executed renewal is treated as authoritative.
